Sure, with two conditions up front. Success criteria come first: before a single case exists, settle what the plugin must achieve, for example 'the capture skill files 9 of 10 save requests in the right folder'. And every case input gets read and approved by you before it is written, including any sample note files used as fixtures.

With those in place, the case writing itself goes to `claude plugin eval init ./plugins/notes`: it interviews you for cases and graders and writes them in the layout its runner reads.

If you seed cases from real sessions, rewrite them rather than pasting the raw transcripts, and swap out any names or paths from your own machine.
pass.why: P-caveat: both points stated plainly, plus the welcome transcripts note and a fixture-files detail that touch neither point.
